title: Balsami-Cal
summary: BALSAM'I-CAL, adjective Having the qualities of balsam; stimulating; unctuous; soft; mitigating; mild. BALSAM'IC, noun A warm, stimulating, demulcent medicine, of a smooth and oily consistence.
